original_users.rule: Design 1 uses 10000 active users in the v4_to_v5 retained request window: all 6734 active members of the original 9433-user Motivation union plus 3266 label-free hash-selected additions. The continuous pool is the original union plus these additions (12699 users). Original 3000/9433 sets remain reference groups.
original_users.calibration_rule: 256 fitting users then 16 validation users in the original reservation order. Continuous phases reuse the v0_to_v1 reservation across targets, using only pre-release histories. Remaining 240 users are reserved for later policy work.
original_users.legacy_canary_note: One member was an old canary on another edge; all current groups are development roles. Pilots are nested development subsets, not independent confirmation.

expansion.candidate_population: UIDs present in retained V4->V5 requests; no outcome values used
expansion.excluded: All five read-correction fitting reservations plus original selective-recompute calibration/canary users; exclusion applies to additions and preserves existing legacy membership.
expansion.rule: Sort SHA256(namespace/uid), then UID; take the first 3266. The activity restriction defines a retrospective development cohort, not an online scheduling policy.
expansion.post_selection: Freeze all selected users regardless of subsequently measured Full/Reuse/Q/H outcomes.

original_users.pilot_rule: Retain the original SHA256-ordered preflight subsets from the named source groups; they are subsets of the expanded evaluation populations.

selection.rule: Proportional strata; largest-remainder quotas; stable SHA256 UID order within strata.
selection.pool_scope: Existing retrospective development pool includes outcome-conditioned Motivation users. This new sampling is label-free within that pool, not a population confirmation sample.

panel_binding.state_rule: Materialize V2 once before D259; inherit actual K/V through releases D259,D273,D287; append chronological history and evict normally, including users without requests.
panel_binding.request_rule: Queries precede all events at the same timestamp; retained labels only score requests.

scope: Identical resident raw prefix and query inputs. Full rebuilds retained history once with Current weights, then reads its rebuilt cache; correction prepares narrow codes from the already-existing old cache and Current item embeddings, then reads old cache with correction. Both use optimized native attention and the same query input staging. First-request timings include preparation, not offline fitting. Eager CUDA events include launch gaps; graph runs remove Python launch overhead for both. Excludes host transfer, queueing and loaded service.
candidate: Full-item rank8 shared codes with Key and Value decoders; no Response
